steps.text: Talk to Mosol Rei east of Shilo Village in south Karamja to receive a wampum belt.
choices: Why do I need to run?
Rashiliyia? Who is she?
I'll go to see the Shaman.
Yes, I'm sure and I'll take the Wampum belt to Trufitus.
What can we do?

steps.text: Show the wampum belt to Trufitus in Tai Bwo Wannai village.
choices: Mosol gave me something to show you.
Mosol Rei said something about a legend?
Why was it called Ah Za Rhoon?
I am going to search for Ah Za Rhoon!
Yes.

steps.text: Use a spade on the ground in south east Karamja.
Look at the mound of earth in south east Karamja.
Use a lit torch or candle on the fissure.
choices: Yes

steps.text: Use a rope on the fissure.
Right-click search the fissure.
choices: Yes, I'll give it a go!

steps.text: Search the nearby cave-in to go deeper in the caverns.
choices: Yes, I'll wriggle through.

steps.text: Search the loose rocks to the north for a tattered scroll.
choices: Yes, I'll carefully move the rocks to see what's behind them.

steps.text: Search the old sacks to the east for a crumpled scroll.
Right-click search the gallows in the north east corner for a corpse.
choices: Yes, I may find something else on the corpse.

steps.text: Use Zadimus's corpse on Trufitus.
choices: Is there any sacred ground around here?

steps.text: Read the tattered scroll.
choices: Yes please.

steps.text: Read the crumpled scroll.
choices: Yes please.

steps.text: Bury Zadimus's corpse in the middle of Tai Bwo Wannai.
Right-click search the rocks on Cairn Isle.
choices: Yes please, I can think of nothing nicer!

steps.text: Right-click search the tomb dolmen to the south.
Use a chisel on the pommel.
Use bronze wire on the beads.
Search the palm trees in the north east of Karamja. Come equipped for a boss fight.
Right-click search the carved doors behind the palm trees.
Use a chisel on the bone shard.
Use the bone key on the doors behind the palm trees.
Enter the doors behind the palm trees.
Equip the beads of the dead, then make your way through the gate, down the rocks, then to the south west corner. Use bones on the door there.
Search the tomb dolmen, ready to fight.
Defeat Nazastarool's 3 forms. You can safe spot them over the tomb dolmen. The Crumble Undead spell is very strong against them.
Pickup Rashiliyia's corpse.
Right-click search the rocks on Cairn Isle to enter the caverns again.
choices: Yes please, I can think of nothing nicer!

steps.text: Use Rashiliyia's corpse on the dolmen to the south.
